in_marathi.name: Aku
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Short form of Akua or Aakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aku is a short form of the Sanskrit names Akua or Aakar. Akua means 'beautiful' or 'graceful', while Aakar means 'form' or 'manifestation'. In Hindu mythology, Aku is associated with the goddess Parvati, symbolizing feminine power, love, and beauty.
